from datetime import date, time

from vedic_astro.chart import build_kundali_chart
from vedic_astro.chart_render import (
    SOUTH_INDIAN_GRID,
    ashtakavarga_mini_grid,
    bhava_chalit_layout,
    navamsa_layout,
    south_indian_layout,
    varga_layout,
)
from vedic_astro.models import BirthData, Sign
from vedic_astro.varga import navamsa_sign


def _sample_birth_data() -> BirthData:
    return BirthData(
        birth_date=date(1990, 6, 15),
        birth_time=time(8, 30, 0),
        latitude=13.0827,
        longitude=80.2707,
        utc_offset_hours=5.5,
    )


def test_grid_is_four_by_four() -> None:
    assert len(SOUTH_INDIAN_GRID) == 4
    assert all(len(row) == 4 for row in SOUTH_INDIAN_GRID)


def test_center_cells_are_blank() -> None:
    assert SOUTH_INDIAN_GRID[1][1] is None
    assert SOUTH_INDIAN_GRID[1][2] is None
    assert SOUTH_INDIAN_GRID[2][1] is None
    assert SOUTH_INDIAN_GRID[2][2] is None


def test_every_sign_appears_exactly_once() -> None:
    signs = [cell for row in SOUTH_INDIAN_GRID for cell in row if cell is not None]
    assert sorted(signs, key=lambda s: s.value) == sorted(list(Sign), key=lambda s: s.value)


def test_grid_border_is_clockwise_from_aries() -> None:
    # Walking the border starting at Aries should visit all 12 signs in order.
    border = [
        SOUTH_INDIAN_GRID[0][1], SOUTH_INDIAN_GRID[0][2], SOUTH_INDIAN_GRID[0][3],
        SOUTH_INDIAN_GRID[1][3], SOUTH_INDIAN_GRID[2][3], SOUTH_INDIAN_GRID[3][3],
        SOUTH_INDIAN_GRID[3][2], SOUTH_INDIAN_GRID[3][1], SOUTH_INDIAN_GRID[3][0],
        SOUTH_INDIAN_GRID[2][0], SOUTH_INDIAN_GRID[1][0], SOUTH_INDIAN_GRID[0][0],
    ]
    assert border == list(Sign)


def test_south_indian_layout_marks_ascendant_as_house_one() -> None:
    chart = build_kundali_chart(_sample_birth_data())
    grid = south_indian_layout(chart)
    ascendant_cells = [
        cell for row in grid for cell in row if cell is not None and cell.is_ascendant
    ]
    assert len(ascendant_cells) == 1
    assert ascendant_cells[0].sign == chart.ascendant.sign
    assert ascendant_cells[0].house == 1


def test_south_indian_layout_places_planets_in_correct_sign_cell() -> None:
    chart = build_kundali_chart(_sample_birth_data())
    grid = south_indian_layout(chart)
    sun = next(p for p in chart.planets if p.planet.value == "Sun")
    sun_cell = next(
        cell for row in grid for cell in row if cell is not None and cell.sign == sun.sign
    )
    assert "Su" in [label.code for label in sun_cell.planet_labels]


def test_navamsa_layout_marks_d9_ascendant_as_house_one() -> None:
    chart = build_kundali_chart(_sample_birth_data())
    grid = navamsa_layout(chart)
    expected_d9_ascendant = navamsa_sign(chart.ascendant.longitude)
    ascendant_cells = [
        cell for row in grid for cell in row if cell is not None and cell.is_ascendant
    ]
    assert len(ascendant_cells) == 1
    assert ascendant_cells[0].sign == expected_d9_ascendant
    assert ascendant_cells[0].house == 1


def test_navamsa_layout_places_planets_by_d9_sign_not_d1_sign() -> None:
    chart = build_kundali_chart(_sample_birth_data())
    grid = navamsa_layout(chart)
    sun = next(p for p in chart.planets if p.planet.value == "Sun")
    assert sun.navamsa_sign is not None
    sun_cell = next(
        cell for row in grid for cell in row if cell is not None and cell.sign == sun.navamsa_sign
    )
    assert "Su" in [label.code for label in sun_cell.planet_labels]


def test_varga_layout_matches_south_indian_layout_for_d1() -> None:
    chart = build_kundali_chart(_sample_birth_data())
    assert varga_layout(chart, "D1") == south_indian_layout(chart)


def test_varga_layout_marks_the_chart_specific_ascendant_as_house_one() -> None:
    chart = build_kundali_chart(_sample_birth_data())
    grid = varga_layout(chart, "D10")
    ascendant_cells = [
        cell for row in grid for cell in row if cell is not None and cell.is_ascendant
    ]
    assert len(ascendant_cells) == 1
    assert ascendant_cells[0].sign == chart.ascendant.varga_signs["D10"]
    assert ascendant_cells[0].house == 1


def test_varga_layout_places_planets_by_their_own_varga_sign() -> None:
    chart = build_kundali_chart(_sample_birth_data())
    grid = varga_layout(chart, "D3")
    sun = next(p for p in chart.planets if p.planet.value == "Sun")
    sun_d3_sign = sun.varga_signs["D3"]
    sun_cell = next(
        cell for row in grid for cell in row if cell is not None and cell.sign == sun_d3_sign
    )
    assert "Su" in [label.code for label in sun_cell.planet_labels]


def test_bhava_chalit_layout_places_planets_by_d1_sign() -> None:
    chart = build_kundali_chart(_sample_birth_data())
    grid = bhava_chalit_layout(chart)
    sun = next(p for p in chart.planets if p.planet.value == "Sun")
    sun_cell = next(
        cell for row in grid for cell in row if cell is not None and cell.sign == sun.sign
    )
    assert "Su" in [label.code for label in sun_cell.planet_labels]


def test_bhava_chalit_layout_has_exactly_one_house_one_cell() -> None:
    chart = build_kundali_chart(_sample_birth_data())
    grid = bhava_chalit_layout(chart)
    house_one_cells = [cell for row in grid for cell in row if cell is not None and cell.house == 1]
    assert len(house_one_cells) == 1
    assert house_one_cells[0].is_ascendant


def test_bhava_chalit_layout_covers_all_twelve_houses_exactly_once() -> None:
    # True for this moderate-latitude fixture, but not a guaranteed property
    # of Placidus cusps in general - at extreme latitudes, house spans can
    # be uneven enough that a house catches zero or two sign-midpoints. This
    # is a regression check for the sample data, not a universal invariant.
    chart = build_kundali_chart(_sample_birth_data())
    grid = bhava_chalit_layout(chart)
    houses = sorted(cell.house for row in grid for cell in row if cell is not None)
    assert houses == list(range(1, 13))


def test_planet_labels_carry_dignity_suffix_and_color_class() -> None:
    chart = build_kundali_chart(_sample_birth_data())
    grid = south_indian_layout(chart)
    saturn = next(p for p in chart.planets if p.planet.value == "Saturn")
    saturn_cell = next(
        cell for row in grid for cell in row if cell is not None and cell.sign == saturn.sign
    )

    assert saturn_label.color_class == "planet-color-saturn"
    # Saturn is Own Sign in this fixture (Capricorn), not Exalted/Debilitated.
    assert saturn_label.dignity_suffix == ""


def test_chart_cells_carry_direction_and_element() -> None:
    chart = build_kundali_chart(_sample_birth_data())
    grid = south_indian_layout(chart)
    aries_cell = next(
        cell for row in grid for cell in row if cell is not None and cell.sign == Sign.ARIES
    )
    assert aries_cell.direction == "E"
    assert aries_cell.element_symbol


def test_ashtakavarga_mini_grid_shows_bindus_and_natal_occupation() -> None:

    cells = [cell for row in grid for cell in row if cell is not None]
    assert len(cells) == 12
    assert sum(cell.bindus for cell in cells) == 337
    for cell in cells:
        assert cell.is_natal_occupied == (cell.sign in natal_signs)

"""Vedic planetary aspects (graha drishti).

Every planet aspects the 7th house from its own position (180 degrees) - a
universal rule. Mars, Jupiter, and Saturn additionally cast "special"
aspects beyond the 7th:
- Mars: 4th and 8th
- Jupiter: 5th and 9th
- Saturn: 3rd and 10th
Sun, Moon, Mercury, and Venus have only the 7th aspect.

Rahu/Ketu are deliberately NOT given aspect rules here as a source (their
drishti is genuinely disputed across classical sources, unlike the 7
classical grahas above) - they can still be the TARGET of another planet's
aspect, just never the source of one.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from vedic_astro.models import SIGNS_IN_ORDER, Planet, PlanetAspect, PlanetPosition, Sign

_MODALITY: dict[Sign, str] = {
    Sign.ARIES: "movable", Sign.CANCER: "movable", Sign.LIBRA: "movable", Sign.CAPRICORN: "movable",
    Sign.TAURUS: "fixed", Sign.LEO: "fixed", Sign.SCORPIO: "fixed", Sign.AQUARIUS: "fixed",
    Sign.GEMINI: "dual", Sign.VIRGO: "dual", Sign.SAGITTARIUS: "dual", Sign.PISCES: "dual",
}


def sign_aspects(sign: Sign) -> list[Sign]:
    """Rashi Drishti (sign-to-sign aspect) - a separate classical system from
    graha drishti above: which SIGNS aspect which, independent of which
    planets occupy them. Movable signs aspect all fixed signs except the one
    immediately adjacent (and vice versa); dual signs aspect the other three
    dual signs.
    """
    modality = _MODALITY[sign]
    index = SIGNS_IN_ORDER.index(sign)
    adjacent = {SIGNS_IN_ORDER[(index - 1) % 12], SIGNS_IN_ORDER[(index + 1) % 12]}

    if modality == "movable":
        return [s for s in SIGNS_IN_ORDER if _MODALITY[s] == "fixed" and s not in adjacent]
    if modality == "fixed":
        return [s for s in SIGNS_IN_ORDER if _MODALITY[s] == "movable" and s not in adjacent]
    return [s for s in SIGNS_IN_ORDER if _MODALITY[s] == "dual" and s != sign]

# House offsets (counted inclusively from the planet's own house) that each
# planet aspects. The 7th is universal; entries beyond [7] are the "special"
# aspects unique to that planet.
ASPECT_OFFSETS: dict[Planet, list[int]] = {
    Planet.SUN: [7],
    Planet.MOON: [7],
    Planet.MERCURY: [7],
    Planet.VENUS: [7],
    Planet.MARS: [4, 7, 8],
    Planet.JUPITER: [5, 7, 9],
    Planet.SATURN: [3, 7, 10],
}

SPECIAL_OFFSETS: dict[Planet, list[int]] = {
    Planet.MARS: [4, 8],
    Planet.JUPITER: [5, 9],
    Planet.SATURN: [3, 10],
}


def aspected_houses(planet: Planet, from_house: int) -> list[int]:
    """Which houses (1-12) this planet aspects, given its own house position.
    Rahu/Ketu (and anything else with no defined rule) aspect nothing here.
    """
    offsets = ASPECT_OFFSETS.get(planet, [])
    return sorted({((from_house - 1 + offset - 1) % 12) + 1 for offset in offsets})


def compute_aspects(planets: list[PlanetPosition]) -> list[PlanetAspect]:
    """All planet-to-planet aspects among the given planets, based on house
    position - i.e. which planets sit in a house that another planet's
    sign-to-sign (rashi) drishti reaches.
    """
    results: list[PlanetAspect] = []
    for source in planets:
        houses_reached = aspected_houses(source.planet, source.house)
        if not houses_reached:
            continue
        special_offsets = set(SPECIAL_OFFSETS.get(source.planet, []))
        for target in planets:
            if target.house not in houses_reached:
                continue
            offset = ((target.house - source.house) % 12) + 1
            results.append(
                PlanetAspect(
                    source_planet=source.planet,
                    source_house=source.house,
                    target_planet=target.planet,
                    target_house=target.house,
                    is_special=offset in special_offsets,
                )
            )
    return results

"""Standalone, single-person dosha rules - no aggregate Doshas/Yogas tab yet
(that stays deferred, same as the Yoga tab). Saturn-specific doshas live
here (natal Shani Dosha/Neech Dosha, plus the 3 Saturn-conjunction
doshas); Kalasarpa/Kuja/Guru Chandala live in general_doshas.py; Mangal
Dosha lives in matching.py since it's specific to the two-person
Ashtakoot marriage-matching context.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from vedic_astro.models import (
    Planet,
    PlanetAspect,
    PlanetPosition,
    SaturnAfflictionDoshas,
    SaturnPairDosha,
    ShaniDoshaResult,
    Sign,
)

_HOUSE_DOSHA_REASONS: dict[int, str] = {
    1: (
        "Saturn in the 1st House (Lagna): a highly serious childhood, "
        "delayed personal identity, and early health struggles."
    ),
    4: (
        "Saturn in the 4th House: disrupts Sukha Bhava (domestic happiness) "
        "- strain with the mother, or a perpetual struggle to feel settled "
        "at home."
    ),
    7: (
        "Saturn in the 7th House: heavily delays marriage (often past age "
        "30-32) and causes friction in business partnerships."
    ),
    8: (
        "Ashtama Shani (Saturn in the 8th House): sudden crises, "
        "inheritance disputes, ongoing chronic health issues, and hidden "
        "emotional burdens."
    ),
    12: (
        "Saturn in the 12th House: unexpected medical or hidden expenses, "
        "severe sleep disorders, and isolation."
    ),
}

_NEECH_DOSHA_REASON = (
    "Shani Neech Dosha: Saturn is debilitated in Aries - poor "
    "decision-making, a lack of patience, and a sense that genuine hard "
    "work is going unrewarded."
)


def compute_shani_dosha(planets: list[PlanetPosition]) -> ShaniDoshaResult:
    saturn = next(p for p in planets if p.planet == Planet.SATURN)

    house_reason = _HOUSE_DOSHA_REASONS.get(
        saturn.house,
        f"Saturn is in House {saturn.house} - no permanent natal Shani "
        "Dosha from house position.",
    )
    has_neech_dosha = saturn.sign == Sign.ARIES
    neech_reason = (
        _NEECH_DOSHA_REASON
        if has_neech_dosha
        else f"Saturn is in {saturn.sign.value} - not debilitated (would need to be in Aries)."
    )
    return ShaniDoshaResult(
        has_house_dosha=saturn.house in _HOUSE_DOSHA_REASONS,
        house_reason=house_reason,
        has_neech_dosha=has_neech_dosha,
        neech_reason=neech_reason,
    )


def planets_conjunct_or_aspecting(
    planet_a: Planet,
    planet_b: Planet,
    planets: list[PlanetPosition],
    aspects: list[PlanetAspect],
) -> tuple[bool, bool]:
    """(has_dosha, is_conjunction). Same house is a symmetric conjunction
    check; otherwise checks whether either planet's Graha Drishti aspect
    (chart.aspects, already computed) reaches the other's house. Since
    aspects.py never emits Rahu/Ketu as an aspect *source* (a pre-existing,
    documented limitation - disputed across classical sources), any dosha
    built on this helper involving Rahu/Ketu is naturally one-directional
    (e.g. Saturn aspecting Rahu, never Rahu aspecting Saturn) without any
    special-casing here - same-house conjunction stays fully symmetric
    regardless."""
    a = next(p for p in planets if p.planet == planet_a)
    b = next(p for p in planets if p.planet == planet_b)
    if a.house == b.house:
        return True, True
    is_aspecting = any(
        (asp.source_planet == planet_a and asp.target_planet == planet_b)
        or (asp.source_planet == planet_b and asp.target_planet == planet_a)
        for asp in aspects
    )
    return is_aspecting, False


def pair_dosha_reason(name: str, a: Planet, b: Planet, has_dosha: bool, is_conjunction: bool) -> str:
    if not has_dosha:
        return f"No conjunction or mutual aspect between {a.value} and {b.value} - no {name}."
    relation = "share the same house (conjunction)" if is_conjunction else "aspect each other"
    return f"{a.value} and {b.value} {relation} - {name} applies."


def compute_saturn_afflictions(
    planets: list[PlanetPosition], aspects: list[PlanetAspect]
) -> SaturnAfflictionDoshas:
    """Vish Dosha (Saturn-Moon), Shani Mangal Dosha (Saturn-Mars), and Shani
    Rahu Dosha / Shapit Yoga (Saturn-Rahu, one-directional - see
    planets_conjunct_or_aspecting). Scope note: only Saturn+Rahu is
    implemented for Shapit Yoga, not Saturn+Ketu - not requested."""
    vish_has, vish_conj = planets_conjunct_or_aspecting(Planet.SATURN, Planet.MOON, planets, aspects)
    mangal_has, mangal_conj = planets_conjunct_or_aspecting(
        Planet.SATURN, Planet.MARS, planets, aspects
    )
    rahu_has, rahu_conj = planets_conjunct_or_aspecting(Planet.SATURN, Planet.RAHU, planets, aspects)
    return SaturnAfflictionDoshas(
        vish_dosha=SaturnPairDosha(
            name="Vish Dosha",
            has_dosha=vish_has,
            is_conjunction=vish_conj,
            reason=pair_dosha_reason("Vish Dosha", Planet.SATURN, Planet.MOON, vish_has, vish_conj),
        ),
        shani_mangal_dosha=SaturnPairDosha(
            name="Shani Mangal Dosha",
            has_dosha=mangal_has,
            is_conjunction=mangal_conj,
            reason=pair_dosha_reason(
                "Shani Mangal Dosha", Planet.SATURN, Planet.MARS, mangal_has, mangal_conj
            ),
        ),
        shani_rahu_dosha=SaturnPairDosha(
            name="Shani Rahu Dosha (Shapit Yoga)",
            has_dosha=rahu_has,
            is_conjunction=rahu_conj,
            reason=pair_dosha_reason(
                "Shani Rahu Dosha (Shapit Yoga)", Planet.SATURN, Planet.RAHU, rahu_has, rahu_conj
            ),
        ),
    )

"""Nakshatra (lunar mansion) and pada lookup from sidereal ecliptic longitude."""

from __future__ import annotations

from vedic_astro.models import NakshatraPlacement, NavataraEntry, Planet

NAKSHATRA_SPAN = 360 / 27  # 13d20', one nakshatra
PADA_SPAN = NAKSHATRA_SPAN / 4  # 3d20', one pada
_EPSILON = 1e-9  # guards float boundary rounding right at a nakshatra/pada edge

NAKSHATRA_NAMES: list[str] = [
    "Ashwini", "Bharani", "Krittika", "Rohini", "Mrigashira", "Ardra",
    "Punarvasu", "Pushya", "Ashlesha", "Magha", "Purva Phalguni", "Uttara Phalguni",
    "Hasta", "Chitra", "Swati", "Vishakha", "Anuradha", "Jyeshtha",
    "Mula", "Purva Ashadha", "Uttara Ashadha", "Shravana", "Dhanishta", "Shatabhisha",
    "Purva Bhadrapada", "Uttara Bhadrapada", "Revati",
]

# Vimshottari dasha lord cycle (also used directly by dasha.py for mahadasha
# and antardasha sequencing) - repeated 3x here to cover all 27 nakshatras.
DASHA_LORD_CYCLE: list[Planet] = [
    Planet.KETU, Planet.VENUS, Planet.SUN, Planet.MOON, Planet.MARS,
    Planet.RAHU, Planet.JUPITER, Planet.SATURN, Planet.MERCURY,
]
NAKSHATRA_LORDS: list[Planet] = DASHA_LORD_CYCLE * 3

# Tara (star) categories: counting from one nakshatra to another (mod 9)
# names the relationship - used both for the Ashtakoot Tara koota
# (matching.py, between two people) and the Navatara Chakra tool (one
# person's Moon nakshatra against all 27). Shared here so both use the same
# tested logic. Classical inclusive counting: `from_index` itself is
# position 1 (Janma).
TARA_NAMES: list[str] = [
    "Janma", "Sampat", "Vipat", "Kshema", "Pratyak", "Sadhaka", "Vadha", "Mitra", "Parama Mitra",
]
TARA_FAVORABLE: set[str] = {"Sampat", "Kshema", "Sadhaka", "Mitra", "Parama Mitra"}


def tara_category(from_index: int, to_index: int) -> str:
    """Classical inclusive counting: `from_index` itself is position 1
    (Janma), the next nakshatra is position 2 (Sampat), ..., 9 stars later
    wraps back to position 1. E.g. tara_category(1, 1) == "Janma" (your own
    nakshatra counted from itself), tara_category(1, 2) == "Sampat".
    """
    position = (to_index - from_index) % 9  # 0-8
    return TARA_NAMES[position]


def compute_navatara_chakra(moon_nakshatra_index: int) -> list[NavataraEntry]:
    """All 27 nakshatras classified by their Tara (star) relationship to the
    given Moon nakshatra (1-27) - the Navatara Chakra reference table."""
    return [
        NavataraEntry(
            nakshatra=NAKSHATRA_NAMES[target_index - 1],
            nakshatra_index=target_index,
            tara_category=(category := tara_category(moon_nakshatra_index, target_index)),
            is_favorable=category in TARA_FAVORABLE,
        )
        for target_index in range(1, 28)
    ]


def nakshatra_for_longitude(longitude: float) -> NakshatraPlacement:
    longitude = longitude % 360
    index = min(int((longitude + _EPSILON) // NAKSHATRA_SPAN), 26)
    within_nakshatra = longitude - index * NAKSHATRA_SPAN
    pada = min(int((within_nakshatra + _EPSILON) // PADA_SPAN) + 1, 4)
    return NakshatraPlacement(
        name=NAKSHATRA_NAMES[index],
        index=index + 1,
        pada=pada,
        lord=NAKSHATRA_LORDS[index],
    )

"""Standalone, single-person dosha rules - no aggregate Doshas/Yogas tab yet
(that stays deferred, same as the Yoga tab). Saturn-specific doshas live
here (natal Shani Dosha/Neech Dosha, plus the 3 Saturn-conjunction
doshas); Kalasarpa/Kuja/Guru Chandala live in general_doshas.py; Mangal
Dosha lives in matching.py since it's specific to the two-person
Ashtakoot marriage-matching context.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from vedic_astro.models import (
    Planet,
    PlanetAspect,
    PlanetPosition,
    SaturnAfflictionDoshas,
    SaturnPairDosha,
    ShaniDoshaResult,
    Sign,
)

_HOUSE_DOSHA_REASONS: dict[int, str] = {
    1: (
        "Saturn in the 1st House (Lagna): a highly serious childhood, "
        "delayed personal identity, and early health struggles."
    ),
    4: (
        "Saturn in the 4th House: disrupts Sukha Bhava (domestic happiness) "
        "- strain with the mother, or a perpetual struggle to feel settled "
        "at home."
    ),
    7: (
        "Saturn in the 7th House: heavily delays marriage (often past age "
        "30-32) and causes friction in business partnerships."
    ),
    8: (
        "Ashtama Shani (Saturn in the 8th House): sudden crises, "
        "inheritance disputes, ongoing chronic health issues, and hidden "
        "emotional burdens."
    ),
    12: (
        "Saturn in the 12th House: unexpected medical or hidden expenses, "
        "severe sleep disorders, and isolation."
    ),
}

_NEECH_DOSHA_REASON = (
    "Shani Neech Dosha: Saturn is debilitated in Aries - poor "
    "decision-making, a lack of patience, and a sense that genuine hard "
    "work is going unrewarded."
)


def compute_shani_dosha(planets: list[PlanetPosition]) -> ShaniDoshaResult:
    saturn = next(p for p in planets if p.planet == Planet.SATURN)

    house_reason = _HOUSE_DOSHA_REASONS.get(
        saturn.house,
        f"Saturn is in House {saturn.house} - no permanent natal Shani "
        "Dosha from house position.",
    )
    has_neech_dosha = saturn.sign == Sign.ARIES
    neech_reason = (
        _NEECH_DOSHA_REASON
        if has_neech_dosha
        else f"Saturn is in {saturn.sign.value} - not debilitated (would need to be in Aries)."
    )
    return ShaniDoshaResult(
        has_house_dosha=saturn.house in _HOUSE_DOSHA_REASONS,
        house_reason=house_reason,
        has_neech_dosha=has_neech_dosha,
        neech_reason=neech_reason,
    )


def planets_conjunct_or_aspecting(
    planet_a: Planet,
    planet_b: Planet,
    planets: list[PlanetPosition],
    aspects: list[PlanetAspect],
) -> tuple[bool, bool]:
    """(has_dosha, is_conjunction). Same house is a symmetric conjunction
    check; otherwise checks whether either planet's Graha Drishti aspect
    (chart.aspects, already computed) reaches the other's house. Since
    aspects.py never emits Rahu/Ketu as an aspect *source* (a pre-existing,
    documented limitation - disputed across classical sources), any dosha
    built on this helper involving Rahu/Ketu is naturally one-directional
    (e.g. Saturn aspecting Rahu, never Rahu aspecting Saturn) without any
    special-casing here - same-house conjunction stays fully symmetric
    regardless."""
    a = next(p for p in planets if p.planet == planet_a)
    b = next(p for p in planets if p.planet == planet_b)
    if a.house == b.house:
        return True, True
    is_aspecting = any(
        (asp.source_planet == planet_a and asp.target_planet == planet_b)
        or (asp.source_planet == planet_b and asp.target_planet == planet_a)
        for asp in aspects
    )
    return is_aspecting, False


def pair_dosha_reason(name: str, a: Planet, b: Planet, has_dosha: bool, is_conjunction: bool) -> str:
    if not has_dosha:
        return f"No conjunction or mutual aspect between {a.value} and {b.value} - no {name}."
    relation = "share the same house (conjunction)" if is_conjunction else "aspect each other"
    return f"{a.value} and {b.value} {relation} - {name} applies."


def compute_saturn_afflictions(
    planets: list[PlanetPosition], aspects: list[PlanetAspect]
) -> SaturnAfflictionDoshas:
    """Vish Dosha (Saturn-Moon), Shani Mangal Dosha (Saturn-Mars), and Shani
    Rahu Dosha / Shapit Yoga (Saturn-Rahu, one-directional - see
    planets_conjunct_or_aspecting). Scope note: only Saturn+Rahu is
    implemented for Shapit Yoga, not Saturn+Ketu - not requested."""
    vish_has, vish_conj = planets_conjunct_or_aspecting(Planet.SATURN, Planet.MOON, planets, aspects)
    mangal_has, mangal_conj = planets_conjunct_or_aspecting(
        Planet.SATURN, Planet.MARS, planets, aspects
    )
    rahu_has, rahu_conj = planets_conjunct_or_aspecting(Planet.SATURN, Planet.RAHU, planets, aspects)
    return SaturnAfflictionDoshas(
        vish_dosha=SaturnPairDosha(
            name="Vish Dosha",
            has_dosha=vish_has,
            is_conjunction=vish_conj,
            reason=pair_dosha_reason("Vish Dosha", Planet.SATURN, Planet.MOON, vish_has, vish_conj),
        ),
        shani_mangal_dosha=SaturnPairDosha(
            name="Shani Mangal Dosha",
            has_dosha=mangal_has,
            is_conjunction=mangal_conj,
            reason=pair_dosha_reason(
                "Shani Mangal Dosha", Planet.SATURN, Planet.MARS, mangal_has, mangal_conj
            ),
        ),
        shani_rahu_dosha=SaturnPairDosha(
            name="Shani Rahu Dosha (Shapit Yoga)",
            has_dosha=rahu_has,
            is_conjunction=rahu_conj,
            reason=pair_dosha_reason(
                "Shani Rahu Dosha (Shapit Yoga)", Planet.SATURN, Planet.RAHU, rahu_has, rahu_conj
            ),
        ),
    )

    is_cancelled = has_dosha and (cancelled_by_conjunction or cancelled_by_nakshatra)

"""Composition root: wires ephemeris + astrology-logic modules into one KundaliChart."""

from __future__ import annotations

from vedic_astro.ashtakavarga import compute_ashtakavarga
from vedic_astro.aspects import compute_aspects
from vedic_astro.dasha import compute_vimshottari_dasha
from vedic_astro.dignity import planet_dignity
from vedic_astro.divisional_charts import VARGA_REGISTRY
from vedic_astro.doshas import compute_saturn_afflictions, compute_shani_dosha
from vedic_astro.ephemeris import ascendant_longitude, house_cusps, planet_positions
from vedic_astro.general_doshas import (
    compute_guru_chandala_dosha,
    compute_kalasarpa_dosha,
    compute_kuja_dosha,
)
from vedic_astro.jaimini import compute_chara_dasha, compute_chara_karakas
from vedic_astro.models import BirthData, HouseSystem, KundaliChart, Planet, PlanetPosition, Sign
from vedic_astro.nakshatra import nakshatra_for_longitude
from vedic_astro.panchanga import compute_panchanga
from vedic_astro.rashi_bhava import (
    build_ascendant,
    degree_in_sign,
    house_from_cusps,
    sign_for_longitude,
    whole_sign_house,
)
from vedic_astro.saturn_transit import compute_saturn_transit_timeline
from vedic_astro.varga import hora_lord, hora_sign, navamsa_sign


def _built_varga_signs(longitude: float) -> dict[str, Sign]:
    return {
        spec.code: spec.sign_fn(longitude)
        for spec in VARGA_REGISTRY
        if spec.sign_fn is not None
    }


def build_kundali_chart(birth_data: BirthData) -> KundaliChart:
    utc_dt = birth_data.utc_datetime
    raw_positions = planet_positions(utc_dt, birth_data.ayanamsha, birth_data.node_type)
    asc_longitude = ascendant_longitude(
        utc_dt, birth_data.latitude, birth_data.longitude, birth_data.ayanamsha
    )
    ascendant = build_ascendant(asc_longitude)
    ascendant = ascendant.model_copy(update={"varga_signs": _built_varga_signs(asc_longitude)})

    cusps: list[float] | None = None
    if birth_data.house_system != HouseSystem.WHOLE_SIGN:
        cusps = house_cusps(
            utc_dt, birth_data.latitude, birth_data.longitude, birth_data.ayanamsha,
            birth_data.house_system,
        )

    # Bhava Chalit is always computed on Placidus, independent of the birth
    # data's own house_system setting (which only ever affects the `house`
    # column above) - otherwise it would be visually identical to the D1
    # chart whenever the user has Whole Sign selected.
    bhava_chalit_cusps = house_cusps(
        utc_dt, birth_data.latitude, birth_data.longitude, birth_data.ayanamsha,
        HouseSystem.PLACIDUS,
    )

    planets: list[PlanetPosition] = []
    # raw_positions preserves the conventional Navagraha order (Sun..Saturn, Rahu, Ketu).
    for planet, raw in raw_positions.items():
        sign = sign_for_longitude(raw.longitude)
        house = (
            house_from_cusps(raw.longitude, cusps)
            if cusps is not None
            else whole_sign_house(sign, ascendant.sign)
        )
        planets.append(
            PlanetPosition(
                planet=planet,
                longitude=raw.longitude,
                sign=sign,
                degree_in_sign=degree_in_sign(raw.longitude),
                house=house,
                nakshatra=nakshatra_for_longitude(raw.longitude),
                retrograde=raw.retrograde,
                navamsa_sign=navamsa_sign(raw.longitude),
                hora_sign=hora_sign(raw.longitude),
                hora_lord=hora_lord(raw.longitude),
                varga_signs=_built_varga_signs(raw.longitude),
                bhava_chalit_house=house_from_cusps(raw.longitude, bhava_chalit_cusps),
                dignity=planet_dignity(planet, sign),
            )
        )

    moon_longitude = raw_positions[Planet.MOON].longitude
    panchanga = compute_panchanga(
        sun_longitude=raw_positions[Planet.SUN].longitude,
        moon_longitude=moon_longitude,
        local_date=birth_data.birth_date,
    )
    dasha = compute_vimshottari_dasha(
        moon_longitude=moon_longitude, birth_datetime=birth_data.local_datetime
    )

    aspects = compute_aspects(planets)
    moon_sign = next(p.sign for p in planets if p.planet == Planet.MOON)

    return KundaliChart(
        birth_data=birth_data,
        ascendant=ascendant,
        planets=planets,
        panchanga=panchanga,
        dasha=dasha,
        aspects=aspects,
        chara_karakas=compute_chara_karakas(planets),
        chara_dasha=compute_chara_dasha(ascendant.sign, planets, birth_data.local_datetime),
        bhava_chalit_cusps=bhava_chalit_cusps,
        ashtakavarga=compute_ashtakavarga(planets, ascendant.sign, bhava_chalit_cusps),
        shani_dosha=compute_shani_dosha(planets),
        saturn_afflictions=compute_saturn_afflictions(planets, aspects),
        saturn_transit=compute_saturn_transit_timeline(birth_data, moon_sign, ascendant.sign),
        kalasarpa_dosha=compute_kalasarpa_dosha(planets),
        kuja_dosha=compute_kuja_dosha(planets, ascendant.sign),
        guru_chandala_dosha=compute_guru_chandala_dosha(planets, aspects),
    )

import pytest

from vedic_astro.doshas import compute_saturn_afflictions, compute_shani_dosha
from vedic_astro.models import NakshatraPlacement, Planet, PlanetAspect, PlanetPosition, Sign

_DUMMY_NAKSHATRA = NakshatraPlacement(name="Ashwini", index=1, pada=1, lord=Planet.KETU)


def _planet(planet: Planet, house: int, sign: Sign = Sign.CAPRICORN) -> PlanetPosition:
    return PlanetPosition(
        planet=planet,
        longitude=0.0,
        sign=sign,
        degree_in_sign=0.0,
        house=house,
        nakshatra=_DUMMY_NAKSHATRA,
        retrograde=False,
    )


def _chart_with_saturn(house: int, sign: Sign = Sign.CAPRICORN) -> list[PlanetPosition]:
    return [_planet(Planet.SATURN, house, sign)]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("house", [1, 4, 7, 8, 12])
def test_shani_dosha_flags_afflicted_houses(house: int) -> None:
    result = compute_shani_dosha(_chart_with_saturn(house))
    assert result.has_house_dosha is True
    assert result.house_reason  # non-empty, house-specific text


@pytest.mark.parametrize("house", [2, 3, 5, 6, 9, 10, 11])
def test_shani_dosha_does_not_flag_other_houses(house: int) -> None:
    result = compute_shani_dosha(_chart_with_saturn(house))
    assert result.has_house_dosha is False
    assert result.house_reason  # still always populated


def test_ashtama_shani_reason_mentions_ashtama_shani() -> None:
    result = compute_shani_dosha(_chart_with_saturn(8))
    assert "Ashtama Shani" in result.house_reason


def test_shani_neech_dosha_flagged_when_saturn_in_aries() -> None:
    result = compute_shani_dosha(_chart_with_saturn(house=5, sign=Sign.ARIES))
    assert result.has_neech_dosha is True
    assert "Neech" in result.neech_reason


def test_shani_neech_dosha_not_flagged_in_own_sign() -> None:
    result = compute_shani_dosha(_chart_with_saturn(house=5, sign=Sign.CAPRICORN))
    assert result.has_neech_dosha is False


def test_shani_neech_dosha_reason_names_the_actual_sign_when_not_flagged() -> None:
    # Regression test: the non-debilitated message used to be fixed
    # boilerplate ("Saturn is not debilitated (not in Aries)") with no
    # indication it was computed from this chart's actual data - two
    # different people whose Saturn just happens to not be in Aries would
    # see byte-identical text, which read as suspicious/copy-pasted even
    # though the underlying flag was correctly computed either way.
    result = compute_shani_dosha(_chart_with_saturn(house=5, sign=Sign.CAPRICORN))
    assert "Capricorn" in result.neech_reason


def test_both_doshas_can_apply_simultaneously() -> None:
    # Saturn in the 1st house AND in Aries - both findings should be
    # independently flagged, not mutually exclusive.
    result = compute_shani_dosha(_chart_with_saturn(house=1, sign=Sign.ARIES))
    assert result.has_house_dosha is True
    assert result.has_neech_dosha is True


def test_vish_dosha_flagged_when_saturn_and_moon_share_a_house() -> None:
    planets = [
        _planet(Planet.SATURN, house=5), _planet(Planet.MOON, house=5),
        _planet(Planet.MARS, house=9), _planet(Planet.RAHU, house=11),
    ]
    result = compute_saturn_afflictions(planets, aspects=[])
    assert result.vish_dosha.has_dosha is True
    assert result.vish_dosha.is_conjunction is True


def test_vish_dosha_flagged_via_aspect_not_conjunction() -> None:
    planets = [
        _planet(Planet.SATURN, house=1), _planet(Planet.MOON, house=7),
        _planet(Planet.MARS, house=9), _planet(Planet.RAHU, house=11),
    ]
    aspects = [
        PlanetAspect(
            source_planet=Planet.SATURN, source_house=1,
            target_planet=Planet.MOON, target_house=7, is_special=False,
        )
    ]
    result = compute_saturn_afflictions(planets, aspects)
    assert result.vish_dosha.has_dosha is True
    assert result.vish_dosha.is_conjunction is False


def test_vish_dosha_not_flagged_without_conjunction_or_aspect() -> None:
    planets = [
        _planet(Planet.SATURN, house=1), _planet(Planet.MOON, house=2),
        _planet(Planet.MARS, house=9), _planet(Planet.RAHU, house=11),
    ]
    result = compute_saturn_afflictions(planets, aspects=[])
    assert result.vish_dosha.has_dosha is False
    assert "No conjunction" in result.vish_dosha.reason


def test_shani_mangal_dosha_flagged_when_conjunct() -> None:
    planets = [
        _planet(Planet.SATURN, house=3), _planet(Planet.MARS, house=3),
        _planet(Planet.MOON, house=9), _planet(Planet.RAHU, house=11),
    ]
    result = compute_saturn_afflictions(planets, aspects=[])
    assert result.shani_mangal_dosha.has_dosha is True
    assert result.shani_mangal_dosha.is_conjunction is True


def test_shani_rahu_dosha_flagged_via_saturns_own_aspect_one_directional() -> None:
    # Rahu is never an aspect *source* in this engine (see aspects.py), so
    # this dosha can only trigger via Saturn's own aspect reaching Rahu, or
    # via same-house conjunction - never via a hypothetical Rahu->Saturn
    # aspect. This test confirms the one-directional entry alone is enough.
    planets = [
        _planet(Planet.SATURN, house=1), _planet(Planet.RAHU, house=7),
        _planet(Planet.MOON, house=9), _planet(Planet.MARS, house=11),
    ]
    aspects = [
        PlanetAspect(
            source_planet=Planet.SATURN, source_house=1,
            target_planet=Planet.RAHU, target_house=7, is_special=False,
        )
    ]
    result = compute_saturn_afflictions(planets, aspects)
    assert result.shani_rahu_dosha.has_dosha is True
    assert result.shani_rahu_dosha.is_conjunction is False


def test_shani_rahu_dosha_not_flagged_when_unrelated() -> None:
    planets = [
        _planet(Planet.SATURN, house=1), _planet(Planet.RAHU, house=2),
        _planet(Planet.MOON, house=9), _planet(Planet.MARS, house=11),
    ]
    result = compute_saturn_afflictions(planets, aspects=[])
    assert result.shani_rahu_dosha.has_dosha is False


def test_all_three_pair_doshas_always_populated_with_a_reason() -> None:
    planets = [
        _planet(Planet.SATURN, house=1), _planet(Planet.MOON, house=2),
        _planet(Planet.MARS, house=3), _planet(Planet.RAHU, house=4),
    ]
    result = compute_saturn_afflictions(planets, aspects=[])
    assert result.vish_dosha.reason
    assert result.shani_mangal_dosha.reason
    assert result.shani_rahu_dosha.reason

import pytest

from vedic_astro.doshas import compute_punarphoo_dosha, compute_saturn_afflictions, compute_shani_dosha
from vedic_astro.models import NakshatraPlacement, Planet, PlanetAspect, PlanetPosition, Sign

_DUMMY_NAKSHATRA = NakshatraPlacement(name="Ashwini", index=1, pada=1, lord=Planet.KETU)


def _planet(
    planet: Planet,
    house: int,
    sign: Sign = Sign.CAPRICORN,
    nakshatra_lord: Planet = Planet.KETU,
) -> PlanetPosition:
    return PlanetPosition(
        planet=planet,
        longitude=0.0,
        sign=sign,
        degree_in_sign=0.0,
        house=house,
        nakshatra=NakshatraPlacement(name="Ashwini", index=1, pada=1, lord=nakshatra_lord),
        retrograde=False,
    )


def _chart_with_saturn(house: int, sign: Sign = Sign.CAPRICORN) -> list[PlanetPosition]:
    return [_planet(Planet.SATURN, house, sign)]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("house", [1, 4, 7, 8, 12])
def test_shani_dosha_flags_afflicted_houses(house: int) -> None:
    result = compute_shani_dosha(_chart_with_saturn(house))
    assert result.has_house_dosha is True
    assert result.house_reason  # non-empty, house-specific text


@pytest.mark.parametrize("house", [2, 3, 5, 6, 9, 10, 11])
def test_shani_dosha_does_not_flag_other_houses(house: int) -> None:
    result = compute_shani_dosha(_chart_with_saturn(house))
    assert result.has_house_dosha is False
    assert result.house_reason  # still always populated


def test_ashtama_shani_reason_mentions_ashtama_shani() -> None:
    result = compute_shani_dosha(_chart_with_saturn(8))
    assert "Ashtama Shani" in result.house_reason

Based on the search results, here's a comprehensive overview of the Shadbala calculation formula and its components:

## Shadbala Formula

The formula is: Total Shadbala = Sthana Bala + Dig Bala + Kala Bala + Cheshta Bala + Naisargika Bala + Drik Bala. The final total is converted to Rupas by dividing by 60.

## The Six Components

The six components are Sthana Bala (positional), Dig Bala (directional), Kala Bala (temporal), Cheshta Bala (motional), Naisargika Bala (natural), and Drik Bala (aspectual).

### Detailed Component Breakdown

**Sthana Bala (Positional Strength):** Sum of five sub-components: Uchcha Bala, Saptavargaja Bala, Ojayugmarasyamsa Bala, Kendradi Bala, and Drekkana Bala. Maximum: 165 virupas (2.75 rupas).

**Dig Bala (Directional Strength):** Sun and Mars are strongest in the 10th house (south), Jupiter and Mercury in the 1st (east), Saturn in the 7th (west), Moon and Venus in the 4th (north). Maximum: 60 virupas (1.0 rupa).

**Kala Bala (Temporal Strength):** Sum of nine sub-components covering day/night strength, lunar phase, year/month/day/hour lordships, and ayanabala.

**Cheshta Bala (Motional Strength):** Based on planetary speed and retrograde state.

**Naisargika Bala (Natural Strength):** Fixed values per planet.

**Drik Bala (Aspectual Strength):** This component represents aspectual strength from other planets' influences.

## Units of Measurement

Shadbala calculations use Virupas (Shashtiamsas) as the primary unit of measurement. The conversion is simple: 60 Virupas = 1 Rupa.

from vedic_astro.rashi_bhava import RASHI_LORD

    Planet.SUN: Sign.ARIES,
    Planet.MOON: Sign.TAURUS,
    Planet.MARS: Sign.CAPRICORN,
    Planet.MERCURY: Sign.VIRGO,
    Planet.JUPITER: Sign.CANCER,
    Planet.VENUS: Sign.PISCES,
    Planet.SATURN: Sign.LIBRA,
}

# Debilitation is always the opposite (7th) sign from exaltation.
DEBILITATION_SIGN: dict[Planet, Sign] = {
    Planet.SUN: Sign.LIBRA,
    Planet.MOON: Sign.SCORPIO,
    Planet.MARS: Sign.CANCER,
    Planet.MERCURY: Sign.PISCES,
    Planet.JUPITER: Sign.CAPRICORN,
    Planet.VENUS: Sign.VIRGO,
    Planet.SATURN: Sign.ARIES,
}

# The deep-exaltation degree - identical in both the exaltation and
# debilitation sign (a planet exalted at 10 degrees of Aries is debilitated
# at 10 degrees of Libra).
DEEP_DIGNITY_DEGREE: dict[Planet, float] = {
    Planet.SUN: 10.0,
    Planet.MOON: 3.0,
    Planet.MARS: 28.0,
    Planet.MERCURY: 15.0,
    Planet.JUPITER: 5.0,
    Planet.VENUS: 27.0,
    Planet.SATURN: 20.0,
}


def planet_dignity(planet: Planet, sign: Sign) -> PlanetDignity:
    if EXALTATION_SIGN.get(planet) == sign:
        return PlanetDignity.EXALTED
    if DEBILITATION_SIGN.get(planet) == sign:
        return PlanetDignity.DEBILITATED
    if RASHI_LORD.get(sign) == planet:
        return PlanetDignity.OWN_SIGN
    return PlanetDignity.NEUTRAL

input.description: Research Shadbala formulas
input.prompt:
You are researching classical Vedic astrology (BPHS-style) formulas so a Python engineer can implement them precisely. This is NOT a coding task - do not write code, just research and report facts with sources. Use WebSearch/WebFetch extensively and cross-verify every numeric formula against at least 2-3 independent sources before reporting it as confident; explicitly flag anything where sources disagree.

## What I need: complete, precise Shadbala (six-fold planetary strength) formulas

Shadbala = Sthana Bala + Dig Bala + Kala Bala + Chesta Bala + Naisargika Bala + Drik Bala, all summed in Virupas (60 Virupas = 1 Rupa). I already know this top-level structure. I need the DETAILED sub-formulas, because a shallow answer isn't enough to implement correctly. Specifically:

### 1. Sthana Bala (positional, max 165 virupas) - 5 sub-parts, need exact formula for EACH:
- **Uchcha Bala**: continuous strength based on angular distance from the planet's exact deep-exaltation degree (max 60 virupas at exact deep exaltation, 0 at the exact debilitation point 180 degrees away). Give the precise formula (e.g. is it linear in degrees? `60 - (angular_distance_from_exaltation/180)*60` or similar?).
- **Saptavargaja Bala**: based on the planet's dignity (own sign / Moolatrikona / great friend / friend / neutral / enemy / great enemy / debilitated) across SEVEN divisional charts. CRITICALLY: which exact 7 divisional charts does classical Saptavargaja Bala use? (I need to know if it's D1,D2,D3,D9,D12,D30,D7 or D1,D2,D3,D9,D12,D30,D60 - sources may differ, flag this explicitly). Give the exact point value for each dignity tier (own sign, moolatrikona, great friend, friend, neutral, enemy, great enemy, debilitated) - this requires the 5-fold Panchadha Maitri (compound friendship: natural + temporal) classification, not just natural friendship. Explain how temporal friendship is computed (which houses from a planet count as temporal friend vs enemy vs neutral, counted from that planet's OWN current position on the chart).
- **Ojayugmarasyamsa Bala**: odd/even sign rule for Sun/Mars/Jupiter/Saturn in D1 and D9 (male planets get points in odd signs, Moon/Venus get points in even signs). Exact virupa values.
- **Kendradi Bala**: points based on whether a planet is in a Kendra (1/4/7/10), Panapara (2/5/8/11), or Apoklima (3/6/9/12) house. Exact virupa values for each.
- **Drekkana Bala**: points based on which of the 3 drekkanas (10-degree divisions) of a sign a planet falls in, differing for male/female/neuter planet classification. Exact values.

### 2. Dig Bala (directional, max 60 virupas)
Exact formula - which house is "full strength" (60 virupas) for each planet (Sun/Mars=10th, Jupiter/Mercury=1st, Saturn=7th, Moon/Venus=4th per what I already found), and the exact formula for strength at intermediate positions (linear falloff based on house/degree distance from the full-strength point and the zero-strength point 180 degrees/7 houses away).

### 3. Kala Bala (temporal, largest component) - list ALL sub-parts with exact formulas:
- Nathonnatha Bala (day/night strength - which planets are strong by day vs night vs both)
- Paksha Bala (based on Moon's waxing/waning, exact formula using Sun-Moon angular distance)
- Tribhaga Bala (day/night divided into 3 parts, which planet lords each part)
- Varsha Bala, Masa Bala, Dina Bala, Hora Bala (year/month/day/hour lords - exact rule for determining each lord and the virupa value awarded)
- Ayana Bala (based on declination/solstice position - exact formula, this one is often cited as complex, please note any source disagreement)
- Yuddha Bala (planetary war adjustment, if considered part of Kala Bala or separate)
Report the exact virupa maximum for each sub-part and how they sum.

### 4. Chesta Bala (motional, max 60 virupas)
Exact formula based on retrograde motion and speed relative to mean motion. Note: this is computed differently for Sun and Moon (who don't retrograde) versus the 5 other planets - explain both cases precisely.

### 5. Naisargika Bala (natural, fixed) - give the exact fixed virupa value for each of the 7 classical planets (Sun through Saturn).

### 6. Drik Bala (aspectual)
Exact formula for how much each planet's Graha Drishti (aspect) onto another planet contributes positive or negative virupas, including the special aspect strength weighting (e.g. Mars/Jupiter/Saturn's special aspects count differently than the universal 7th).

### 7. Required strength / Ishta-Kashta thresholds
The classical minimum Rupa threshold each planet needs to be considered "strong enough" (e.g. Sun needs 5 Rupas, Moon needs 6, etc.) - give the standard table if one exists.

## Context for scoping (don't research this, just know it):
This is for a Python app (pyswisseph-based, sidereal Lahiri ayanamsha, offline). It already has: exact planetary longitudes/degrees, houses (whole-sign and Placidus), retrograde flag and daily motion speed available from the ephemeris, sign lordships (RASHI_LORD table), natural planetary friendship (_FRIENDS/_ENEMIES dict, standard BPHS table) in matching.py, planet dignity (exalted/debilitated/own-sign/neutral, with exact deep-exaltation degree per planet) in dignity.py, and divisional charts D1/D2/D3/D7/D9/D10/D12/D30 built with verified formulas (D4,D5,D6,D8,D11,D16,D20,D24,D27,D40,D45,D60,D81,D108,D144 are NOT built/available). Rahu/Ketu are excluded from dignity scoring in this app (disputed) - assume Shadbala is only computed for the 7 classical planets (Sun through Saturn), not Rahu/Ketu, unless your research finds a very standard exception.

## Output format
A structured report, one section per component above, each formula written out precisely (with the exact numbers/constants), each claim tagged with a confidence level (HIGH = consistent across 3+ sources, MEDIUM = consistent across 2 sources or one authoritative source, LOW/DISPUTED = sources disagree, explain the disagreement). Include your source URLs. Keep it factual and precise - no code, no implementation suggestions, just the astrological formulas and data tables a developer would need. This can be long/detailed - precision matters more than brevity here.

This is NOT a coding task - do not write code, just research and report facts with sources. ## Part A: Vimshopaka Bala (20-point divisional-chart strength score)

I need the exact weight tables for each of the 4 classical variants:
1. **Shadvarga** (6 divisional charts): which 6 charts exactly (I believe D1, D2, D3, D9, D12, D30 - please confirm), and the exact weight/points assigned to EACH of those 6 charts, summing to 20.
2. **Saptavarga** (7 divisional charts): the Shadvarga list plus D7 (or D60? please confirm which) - and the revised weight table (different from Shadvarga's, summing to 20).

4. **Shodashavarga** (16 divisional charts, the fullest classical version): the full list of which 16 charts, and weight table (summing to 20).

For EACH variant, also give the exact per-varga SCORING rule: how many of the 20-point-weighted-share does a planet get for landing in its own sign vs Moolatrikona vs a great friend's sign vs friend's sign vs neutral's sign vs enemy's sign vs great enemy's sign vs exaltation vs debilitation, within that one divisional chart. This is usually expressed as a fraction/percentage of that varga's weight (e.g. "full weight if own sign or exalted, 3/4 if great friend, 1/2 if friend," etc.) - I need the exact fractions/rules, and flag if they differ from source to source.

Also confirm: what are the standard "strength band" interpretations of a final Vimshopaka Bala score out of 20 (e.g. below X = weak, X-Y = average, above Z = strong)?

I need the components of classical Bhava Bala and their exact formulas:
1. **Bhavadhipati Bala** (house-lord strength): confirm this is literally the house lord's own Shadbala (in Rupas or Virupas) - i.e. does Bhava Bala have Shadbala as a hard prerequisite/dependency, or is it computed independently?
2. **Bhava Dig Bala** (house directional strength): exact formula - is this the same Dig Bala concept applied to the house cusp itself rather than to planets, or is it derived differently?
3. **Bhava Drishti Bala** (aspects to the house): how much each aspecting planet contributes to a house's strength via Graha Drishti (or Rashi Drishti?) landing on that house - exact formula.
4. Is there a 4th classical component (sometimes called Bhava Sthana Bala / Bhava Kendradi Bala, based on whether the house itself is a Kendra/Panapara/Apoklima, or is that redundant with Bhava Dig Bala)? Clarify the full, standard list of Bhava Bala components - sources vary on whether it's 3 or 4 parts, please report what you find and flag any disagreement.
5. Units: is Bhava Bala reported in the same Virupa/Rupa units as Shadbala, and what's a typical/standard strength threshold for a house to be considered "strong"?

## Context for scoping (don't research this, just know it):

This matters a lot for Part A: if Dashavarga or Shodashavarga require charts outside that available set (D6, D8, D60, D16, D20, D24, D27, D40, D45), say so explicitly per variant, since only variants using entirely-available charts can be implemented right now - the other variants would have to wait.

## Output format
A structured report (Part A then Part B), each formula/table written out precisely with exact numbers, each claim tagged with a confidence level (HIGH = consistent across 3+ sources, MEDIUM = consistent across 2 sources or one authoritative source, LOW/DISPUTED = sources disagree, explain the disagreement). Include source URLs. Keep it factual - no code, no implementation suggestions, just the astrological data a developer needs. Long/detailed is fine - precision matters more than brevity.

This is for a Python app (pyswisseph-based, sidereal Lahiri ayanamsha, offline). It already has: exact planetary longitudes/degrees, houses (both whole-sign and Placidus/Equal/Porphyry available), sign lordships (RASHI_LORD table), natural planetary friendship (_FRIENDS/_ENEMIES dict, standard BPHS table), planet dignity (exalted/debilitated/own-sign/neutral) with exact deep-exaltation degrees, Graha Drishti (planet-to-planet aspects, including Mars/Jupiter/Saturn's special aspects) already computed, and divisional charts D1/D2/D3/D7/D9/D10/D12/D30 built with verified formulas - D4,D5,D6,D8,D11,D16,D20,D24,D27,D40,D45,D60,D81,D108,D144 are explicitly NOT built (no verified formula sourced yet for those in this app).
